events.title: Java 5 (Tiger) released
events.summary: Sun released [Java] 5 on September 30, 2004 — adding [generics], enums, autoboxing, enhanced for-loops, and annotations.
events.about: [Java] 5 was the biggest language change since [Java] 1.0: `List<String>` replaced raw collections, `@Override` caught typos at compile time, and foreach loops cleaned up iteration. Every enterprise codebase written in the 2000s eventually migrated to Tiger's syntax.

narrative.whyChosen: [Generics] and annotations defined modern [Java] style for a decade.
narrative.whyImportant: Type-safe collections eliminated casts and ClassCastException bugs in production.
narrative.problemSolved: Raw types and verbose loops made large [Java] codebases error-prone and hard to read.
